name: Son Bunyola
insider_take: This 16th-century estate turned ultra-luxury hideaway sits on 810 acres of pristine Mallorcan countryside, where olive groves meet dramatic mountain peaks and exclusive vineyard tastings happen steps from your suite.
whats_special: Son Bunyola is built around a historic possessió (traditional Mallorcan estate) with original stone architecture dating back 500 years. The property features its own organic farm, award-winning olive oil production, and a world-class spa carved into natural rock formations. Only 26 suites and villas ensure ultimate privacy, while the infinity pool seemingly floats above the Tramuntana Mountains—a UNESCO World Heritage site.
pro_tip: Book the Estate Wine Experience to taste rare Mallorcan varietals produced on-site, paired with estate-grown olives and artisanal cheeses—it's only available to hotel guests and sells out quickly.
dont_miss: The secret sunrise hike to Puig de Galatzó peak (accessible only through the hotel's private trails), and dinner at Olivar restaurant where Michelin-trained chefs use ingredients harvested from the estate's gardens that same day. The 13th-century chapel on the grounds hosts intimate concerts featuring local musicians.
pros: Historic finca estate with authentic Mallorcan architecture
Stunning panoramic views of Tramuntana mountains
Luxurious spa with holistic wellness treatments
cons: Remote mountain location requires car for exploring
